pillars.title: 1. Semantic Shift
pillars.definition: The evolution of a word's word-meaning over time, where the underlying concept undergoes pejoration, amelioration, or complete inversion.

pillars.title: 2. Clipping
pillars.definition: The morphological process of shortening a polysyllabic lexeme without altering its core lexical category or semantic intent.

pillars.title: 3. Borrowing
pillars.definition: The adoption of loanwords from external languages or subcultural lexicons into the primary linguistic framework.

pillars.title: 4. Blending
pillars.definition: The coalescence of two distinct lexemes and their meanings to forge a novel compound concept.
